subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this experimental, core-owned grouped Claw manifest and read-only planning contract as the base for the dependent lifecycle stack?
rationale: The patch is a coherent implementation, but choosing a new core CLI, environment gate, schema, and lifecycle abstraction is a maintainer product and ownership decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental core base
options.body: Accept the gated read-only contract and use it as the reviewed base for the dependent creation, workspace, package, and removal slices.

options.title: Keep the concept outside core
options.body: Decline the new core lifecycle contract and route any portable package or workflow ideas through existing plugin, ClawHub, or skill seams.

options.title: Request a narrower RFC-backed base
options.body: Keep this PR open while maintainers specify a smaller core contract or explicit lifecycle ownership boundaries before merge.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the experimental core base
recommendation.body: Accept the gated read-only contract and use it as the reviewed base for the dependent creation, workspace, package, and removal slices.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-head update and prior detailed review connect this person most directly to the final contract and its implementation boundary.
